[[File: Kuksin sergei.jpg | thumb|Sergei Kuksin, [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] 2008]]
'''Sergei Borisovich Kuksin''' (Сергей Борисович Куксин, born 2 March 1955) is a French and Russian mathematician, specializing in [[partial differential equation]]s (PDEs).

Kuksin received his doctorate under the supervision of [[Mark Vishik]] at [[Moscow State University]] in 1981.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=80099}}</ref> He was at the [[Steklov Institute]] in Moscow and at the [[Heriot-Watt University]] and is a ''directeur de recherché'' (senior researcher) at the Institut Mathématiques de Jussieu of the [[Paris Diderot University]] (Paris VII).

His research deals with [[Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Theorem|KAM theory]] in partial differential equations (''i.e.'' infinite dimensional Hamiltonian systems);<ref>{{cite book|author=Dumas, H. Scott|title=The KAM Story: A Friendly Introduction to the Content, History, and Significance of Classical Kolmogorovâ Arnoldâ Moser Theory|publisher=World Scientific Publishing Company|year=2014|page=224|isbn=9789814556606 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=hy48DQAAQBAJ&pg=PA224}}</ref> partial differential equations involved with random perturbations, turbulence and statistical hydrodynamics; and elliptic PDEs for functions between compact manifolds.

In 1992 he was an invited speaker with talk ''KAM theory for partial differential equations'' at the European Congress of European Mathematicians in Paris. In 1998 he was an invited speaker at [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Berlin]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Kuksin, S. B.|chapter=Elements of a qualitative theory of Hamiltonian PDEs|title=''In:'' Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians (Berlin, 1998)|volume=2|pages=819–829|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011669000}}</ref> In 2016 he received the Lyapunov Prize from the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].

* Hamiltonian perturbations of infinite-dimensional linear systems with an imaginary spectrum, Functional Analysis and Applications, Vol. 21, 1987, pp.&nbsp;192–205 {{doi|10.1007/BF02577134}}
* with Jürgen Pöschel: Invariant Cantor manifolds of quasi-periodic oscillations for a nonlinear Schrödinger equation, Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 143, 1996, pp.&nbsp;149–179 {{doi|10.2307/2118656}}
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20180726072010/https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/3628/0adfe20fbbb0611670daed5761a6358dc5c4.pdf A KAM-theorem for equations of the Korteweg-de Vries type], Rev. Math. Phys., Vol. 10, 1998, pp.&nbsp;1–64
* with Armen Shirikyan: Stochastic Dissipative PDE's and Gibbs measures, Communications in Mathematical Physics, Vol. 213, 2000, pp.&nbsp;291–330 {{doi|10.1007/s002200000237}}
* with A. Shirikyan: A Coupling Approach to Randomly Forced Nonlinear PDEs. I, Communications in Mathematical Physics, Vol. 221, 2001, pp.&nbsp;351–366 {{doi|10.1007/s002200100479}}
* with A. Shirikyan: Ergodicity for the randomly forced 2D Navier-Stokes equations, Mathematical Physics, Analysis and Geometry, Vol. 4, 2001, pp.&nbsp;147–195 {{doi|10.1023/A:1011989910997}}
* with [[Håkan Eliasson]]: KAM for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation, Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 188, 2010, pp.&nbsp;371–435 {{JSTOR|20752272}}
